## W10 Informed Intent authorization

W10   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: all four elements are stated; all five authorizer conditions are evidenced as met; and the named approver has signed a decision with its conditions and exit.

Source basis: [DOCTRINE.md](https://github.com/rolldabones/rolldabones/blob/main/DOCTRINE.md) · [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [Definition of Done](https://github.com/rolldabones/definition-of-done) · [AI Impact Assessment Tool](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-Impact-Assessment-Tool)

Informed Intent has two limbs. Both are required and they answer different questions.

**The instrument: what the authorization must contain**

Four elements, all required. Purpose: the specific action, workflow and version, linked to W03 and W08. Authority: on whose authority the action proceeds, with the W04 record. Boundaries: tool and data (W06), users, outputs, permitted decisions and limits. Exit: expiry, retraction conditions and the practical path to a lower tier, manual work or shutdown (W20, W21). An authorization missing its exit is not an authorization.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**The authorizer: whether the signature counts**

Five conditions on the human who grants it, all required. An instrument carrying all four elements, signed by a human lacking any of the five, is paperwork.

| **Condition** | **Evidence the approver has it** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Knowledge | Understands purpose, system limitations and consequences. | ________ |
| Evidence | Can inspect tests, risks, alternatives, uncertainty and dissent. | ________ |
| Authority | Has documented power to make this decision. | ________ |
| Time | Has sufficient time to review before the action. | ________ |
| Permission | Can decline without retaliation or pressure to rubber-stamp. | ________ |

**Alternative considered and remaining concern**

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Decision and conditions**

Authorize specified use, revise, defer, reject or retract. Name condition owners, deadlines and what is allowed before closure.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Materials available at __________  Decision at __________  Evidence pack ID __________

Named approver and authority __________  Signature/date __________  Alternate __________

Any unmet condition blocks this authorization. A blank form, model assertion, meeting attendance or silence does not grant permission.
